description: This file defines an internal sealed class 'AzureAppendBlobLogStorage' that implements the 'IStateMachineStorage' interface, providing functionality for appending, reading, replacing, and deleting log data stored in Azure Blob Storage, specifically using Append Blobs. It manages blob creation, snapshots, copying, and streaming content, with detailed logging and conditions handling.

classes.name: AzureAppendBlobLogStorage
classes.description: An internal sealed class managing append-only storage for logs in Azure Blob Storage, supporting append, replace, delete, and read operations with snapshot and copy management.

methods.name: AppendAsync
methods.description: Appends data to the blob, creating it if it does not exist, and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: DeleteAsync
methods.description: Deletes the blob if it exists, resetting internal counters.

methods.name: ReadAsync
methods.description: Reads and yields log segments from the blob asynchronously, handling zero-length blobs and snapshots.

methods.name: CopyFromSnapshotAsync
methods.description: Copies the blob content from a specified snapshot and returns the streaming result.

methods.name: ReplaceAsync
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current blob state, overwrites the blob with new data, and deletes the snapshot post-write.
